title: Qman DirectPath measured QualificationSubjectManifest
description: Signed measured subject for one E4 qualification. It prevents a QualificationRecord from self-reporting the device, firmware, platform, provider, guest or workload tuple used to derive exactQualificationKey.
x-qmanRunManifestRule: Resolve qualificationRunManifest.path inside evidence commit E, verify exact raw bytes/length/application-json media type, validate only against the pinned QualificationRunManifest schema whose raw hash equals schemaSha256, and verify runDigest plus the independent HOST_INVENTORY_EVIDENCE and TEST_EVIDENCE attestations. Parsed qualificationRunId/hostId/hostEpoch/bootId/deviceUid/deviceRecordHash/current inventory digest, target C/M, platform/backend tuple and COMPLETE/PASSED state byte-equal this Subject and its consuming E4 indexes. Its complete measurementDigest and scenarioExecutionCoreDigest sets are exact bijections with this Subject; startedAt <= every measurement/core/workload observation <= finishedAt <= each run attestation.signedAt <= issuedAt. A Subject without this recursively verified run closure is invalid.
x-qmanMeasurementRule: Resolve every measurementPath inside evidence commit E, verify measurementSha256 over raw bytes, validate only against the pinned directpath-qualification-measurement schema whose raw hash equals schemaSha256, verify its internal measurementDigest/signature/trust role, then apply the fixed /measuredValue projection. Descriptor qualificationRunId/subjectField/sourceKind/observedAt/hostId/hostEpoch/bootId/deviceUid/deviceRecordHash MUST byte-equal the parsed record and this Subject's frozen run/host/epoch/boot/device tuple. Exactly one descriptor exists for each of pciIdentityMatch, deviceArchetype, deviceFirmwareAndRom, kernelQemuFirmwareBackend, iommuInterruptResetProviders, guestDriverAndWorkload and deviceTraits; its projected value byte-equals the corresponding top-level field. deviceArchetype is QUALIFICATION_ENGINEERING-signed from a prior taxonomy/classifier artifact for the same exact device and cannot consume this Subject, its proposed QualificationRecord or final SupportedCatalog. caseExecution has exactly one descriptor for every member of scenarioExecutionCoreDigests and no other descriptor; every projected value equals its paired core digest, so the two sets are a bijection. The complete descriptor array is ordered by [subjectField,sourceKind,measurementDigest], removing any same-field tie ambiguity. All measurements bind this qualificationRunId/hostId/hostEpoch/bootId/deviceUid/deviceRecordHash tuple; non-case measurements additionally bind the current inventory snapshot and are independently derived from raw evidence. A copied or cross-device value is invalid.
x-qmanExactKeyRule: Recompute platformProfileHash from the portable compatibility policy, caseIds from the independently pinned qualification matrix, and derivedExactQualificationKey from the exact same closed projection specified by QualificationRecord. The proposed record must byte-equal every measured field and exact key. Any mismatch denies E4.
x-qmanAcyclicEvidenceRule: scenarioExecutionCoreDigests list the pre-index cores defined by ExecutionEvidenceIndex, never final indexDigest values. Construct each core without the EvidenceIndex and QualificationSubject artifacts; construct and sign all QualificationMeasurements; construct and dual-attest QualificationRunManifest from those measurements and cores; construct and sign this measured Subject next; then construct the E4 EvidenceIndex containing the Subject artifact and the same core digest; finally construct the scenario result, QualificationRecord and CaseCompletionRecord. No earlier object embeds an index, record or completion object that transitively embeds it.
x-qmanDurationRule: workloadObservation.startedAt/finishedAt/monotonicDurationNanoseconds/workloadResultArtifactSha256 byte-equal the parsed QualificationRunManifest workloadResult descriptor, whose duration in turn byte-equals the signed QualificationWorkloadResult.monotonicTiming.durationNanoseconds. Parse the decimal nanoseconds exactly and require it >= guestDriverAndWorkload.minimumDurationSeconds * 1000000000; no truncation, rounding or wall-clock substitution is permitted. The consuming QualificationRecord independently resolves E4-PHYSICAL-QUALIFICATION indexes for every listed core and all required Case IDs.
x-qmanSignatureRule: Set manifestDigest and signature to null, encode the complete object with CANONICAL-JSON-V1, store its SHA-256 in manifestDigest, and sign ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/QUALIFICATION-SUBJECT-MANIFEST/V1) || 0x00 || the same bytes with a non-revoked HOST_INVENTORY_EVIDENCE key. Qualification Engineering independently verifies it before signing QualificationRecord.
